# Capture is sacred

DEFINES line AS the text a person submits in a capture field, holding at least one character outside Unicode White_Space
GOVERNS capture
SO THAT a person adding a task
CAN RELY ON a visible task for every submitted line

## Verification

### Test.Compliance: capture

- task-under-failure: ALWAYS: a submitted line yields exactly one visible task under every interpretation failure.
- line-verbatim: NEVER: a task created under an interpretation failure drops or rewrites any character of the submitted line beyond trimming whitespace at both ends.
- reinterpret-later: ALWAYS: a task created under an interpretation failure can be interpreted again later without retyping its line.

### Audit: messages

- recovery-message: ALWAYS: a message about an uninterpreted line names what was not understood and offers exactly one recovery action.

# Todo

Todo is a personal task manager. It exists so that one person can capture and complete their tasks with the least possible friction. As a list keeper, that person gets every obligation out of their head the moment it appears. As a daily planner, they see today's tasks in order and close them out.

## Product boundaries

Todo serves one person per account and exchanges nothing between accounts.

| Excluded                                   | Rationale                                                           |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Shared task lists                          | Collaboration changes the product into coordination.                |
| Reminders and push notification scheduling | Capture and completion are the product; nagging is a different outcome. |

## Change retention

Todo retains its Changes and their edit history indefinitely.
